Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The England players stride out to the middle, followed by Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq. Saqib Mahmood will start with the ball.

Pakistan were led by Hasan Ali! He was sensational and continued his great form in international cricket over the last few months. Hasan picked up a 5-fer and was instrumental in reducing England in the middle overs. Shaheen Afridi was terrific in his opening spell while Shadab Khan was good in his 10 overs. Saud Shakeel bowled only 3 overs but he started the collapse as he picked up the wicket of the well-set Philip Salt. Haris Rauf started off poorly but then came back well to pick up two in the end. Their fielding was a little poor and they would be disappointed with that. They need to bat much better than what they did in the last game if they want to stay alive in the series. Will they be able to chase it down? We will find out as the chase begins in a while.

England did not get off to a great start as they lost two early wickets, in the form of Dawid Malan and Zak Crawley but Philip Salt and James Vince counter-attacked and put England in a position of strength. Both reached their respective half-centuries and played very well. They though fell in quick succession and that triggered a collapse as they stumbled to 160 for 7. Gregory and Carse stitched a very good stand and have given England a good total on the board. They could have got a little more had Gregory stayed till the end but it was not to be.

A good comeback from England here as they were 160 for 7 at one stage but a very good partnership between Lewis Gregory and Brydon Carse has got them to 247. It is still not a match-winning total but the pitch is supporting the bowlers as well and they would not be too disappointed. Pakistan, on the other hand, would be a tad disappointed that they gave away some runs towards the end but they would know that they are not out of this game yet.

Commentary.Howout: c Haris Rauf b Hasan Ali

OUT! Timber! Saud Shakeel gets his maiden ODI wicket and breaks the 97-run stand. Smart bowling by Saud, he sees the batsman making a move to the off side and pushes it flatter and quicker around off. Salt tries to swipe it on the leg side but misses and finds his furniture disturbed. A good phase of play for Pakistan. They dried up the runs in the last three overs and now have a breakthrough as well. Salt returns after playing an impressive and fearless knock.
Short and outside off, Vince goes back and cracks it to sweeper cover for a run.
Shimmies down the track and smashes a full ball to long off for a single.
Forces a flatter delivery to sweeper cover for a single. 11 runs from the 3 overs of spin post Drinks.
Shadab drags his length short and drops it on middle, Salt goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two.
Goes aerial and lofts a full ball with the spin over covers. One run taken.

Knocks a full ball down to long off for a single.
Tosses up ball on off, Salt pushes it firmly back to the bowler. Another good over for Pakistan.

Well done, Hasan Ali! Loopy ball landing full around off, Salt lofts it over covers and it races away. Hasan Ali chases it down and pulls it back before the rope. But the ball again starts to move towards the boundary line. Hasan reacts quickly to immediately jump back inside the field and stop it from committing the crime. Saves two.
Quicker and flatter on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.

Once again CATCH IT is the shout but it doesn't carry to the fielder. Full and around off, Salt makes room to drive it through covers but it turns away and takes the outside edge. It falls in front of short third man.
In the air.. CATCH IT is the shout but it's safe. Floated one, full and on middle, Vince makes room and chips it over long off for a single.
Beaten! Flighted delivery, full and around off, spinning away, Vince hangs back to push it through the line but misses.
Saud Shakeel comes on now.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it down through wide mid off for a single. Tidy over for Pakistan after Drinks.
Short and wide outside off, Vince cuts but finds point.
Full and outside off, Vince pushes it from the back foot to point where the fielder dives to his right to make the stop.
Edged but safe! A googly by Shadab, on the flatter trajectory outside off, Vince tries to punch without picking it and gets an outside edge. It brushes the pads of Rizwan and deflects to point.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Salt goes back and hammers it to deep cover for a run.

Drinks! England are off to a rollicking start here! They lost two wickets early but Philip Salt and James Vince have counter-attacked in fine fashion. Both have reached their respective fifties and are looking in fine touch. Salt has ridden his luck but has played well. Pakistan, on the other hand, started beautifully with 2 quick wickets but then they have had no answers to the assault from Vince and Salt. They need to pick up wickets and quickly.

FOUR! Fifty for James Vince as well, his 2nd in ODIs. Just a hint of width outside off and Vince smashes it backward of point for a boundary. England's number 4 gets the chance now to raise his bat. This pair has put the hosts in a position of strength.
On middle, turned on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Steers a length ball through cover-point for a single.

FOUR! Edgy! But Salt will take it. His maiden ODI fifty. It has been a seriously entertaining knock by him so far. A length ball on off, PS stays back to close the face of the bat as he attempts to play on the leg side but it kisses the edge and runs down to third man for a boundary. Philip gets the chance to raise his bat in front of a full-strength Lord's crowd. What a moment! Can he make it even bigger? Also, 100 comes up for England in a quick time.
Good length delivery outside off, Salt tries to hammer it through the line but connects only with thin air.
Miscommunication but safe! Fuller in length and on off, Salt pushes it to backward point and looks for a run. A loud shout for a no from Vince and Philip returns.
Eases a length ball through covers for a single. 12 from the over and this has been a rollicking start from England despite losing early wickets.
Allows the slower one to come to him and opens the face of his bat to guide it towards third man. A single.
Slower one but on the shorter side, it's cut through point for two. Runs continue to come thick and fast.

FOUR! Vince has batted with a lot of positive intent here. He has attacked all the short deliveries. On middle and leg, James isn't in too much control but still goes for the pull shot. Top edges it behind for a boundary at fine leg.

FOUR! Calculative risk and it has paid off. Short in length and on off, Vince hangs on the back foot and pulls it in front of square leg. Saud Shakeel comes running in from the deep but it drops short of him and sneaks past for a boundary.

Slightly short in length and around off, Vince goes back to defend it late but it takes the inner half and strikes him on the pads. It deflects to the off side, James looks for a run but is sent back.
Here is the pitched up delivery and here is the outside edge. Although it has gone down safely to third man. Fuller and on off, Vince tries to drive down the ground but edges it behind. A single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Vince rocks back and cracks it behind backward point. The third man fielder runs across to his right to collect the ball and they take a couple.
Good length ball on off, Vince brings down a straight bat and gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! Don't bowl there! Short and wide outside off, plenty of room there, Vince buys it and slaps it through point for a boundary. Azhar Mahmood on Twitter has tweeted advising the Pakistan bowlers to pitch it up and bowl in the line of the stumps. Fair advice.

Terrific running between the wickets. Rauf angles in a length ball on off, slower in pace, Vince plays it nice and late to put it wide of point. The third man fielder is quite deep and it's an easy couple.
Beaten! Superb delivery. On a good length just outside off, shaping in, Vince tries to poke at it but is beaten on the inside edge.

Almost drags it on! Not for the first time Salt has been lucky in this knock. A length ball on off, nipping in, Salt goes hard at it as he tries to drive but it takes the inner half and thuds him on the pads.
In the channel outside off, cutting back in at a slow pace, Salt plays late but finds point.
Faheem pitches it up and outside off, James drives it through covers and collects a single.
A touch short outside off, shaping in, Salt plays it late and glides it down to third man for a single.
Slower one, short and outside off, Salt taps it down to point and looks for a run but it's not on.
Slight bit of movement from a length outside off, Vince tries to defend but gets an inside edge. It squirts through square leg and they cross.

FOUR! Just looking at Salt's shots with a wow expression on my face! This is supreme from Salt! Good length ball outside off, Salt drives it through the cover region for another boundary. England are 72 for 2 at the end of Powerplay 1.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 38th over.
Haris Rauf loses his run-up and pulls out of his delivery stride.
BEATEN! This is much better from Haris Rauf! Good length ball outside off, Salt looks to defend but it goes past the outside edge and it goes to the keeper.

Good length ball around off, Vince looks to defend it with soft hands but it takes the outside edge and it goes to third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, Vince pushes it to the point region.

Double bowling change. Haris Rauf to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1.

FOUR! Make it 4 boundaries in the over! Salt is on fire. Full ball on middle, Salt drives it through mid on, beats the dive of the fielder inside the circle and picks up another boundary.16 from the over!

EDGED AND FOUR! That works as well for Philip Salt! Good length ball outside off, Salt looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge, past the stumps and into the fine leg fence. Salt smiles, everything is going his way at the moment.
FOUR! CRACKED! That made a very good sound off the bat! Short and outside off, Salt punches it through extra cover for a boundary. Philip is going great guns!
Good length ball on middle, Salt presents the full face of the bat and then defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball around off, Salt punches it back to the bowler.

WIDE! Short in length but outside the tramline. Vince looks to play at it first but then decides to let it go. Wided.

Length ball on middle, Salt defends it back to the bowler.

Fullish ball on middle, Salt defends it to mid on.

Once again it's on middle and leg, too full in length, PS flicks it behind square leg and takes a couple. Eventful start to this match.
A yorker around leg, sharp in pace, Salt is beaten in pace as he tries to flick. It goes off his pads to cover-point.

A mistimed shot! On a length around off, angling in, Salt is hurried into the shot as he lofts it over mid on. It clears the infield and they take two. Called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit coming...

FOUR! What a shot! Lovely followthrough of the bat and it's been nailed. Hasan lands it on a length around off, Salt uses his feet to walk forward a bit and spanks it through mid off for a cracking boundary.
Fuller in length and outside off, Salt drives it from the toe end of the bat to covers.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Play and a miss! Shortish and outside off, Salt tries to punch it from the back foot but is beaten by the away movement.

Imam-ul-Haq drops a tough catch! What an effort though by him! Would have been a worldie. Shaheen lands it on a length around middle and off, shaping away, Salt slices his drive at backward point where Imam dives full stretch to his left, gets both his hands onto it but fails to hang on. These are the kind of catches you have seen someone like Jonty Rhodes or Paul Collingwood take in the past. Full marks to the effort. A single has been taken. A nervy beginning from the hosts.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it down to mid on.
Some confusion over a run. Full and around off, some inward shape this time, Salt forces it off the inner half to the right of wide mid on. The batters think of a run but decide against it.
Too full in length and on off, Salt drives but finds the cover fielder.

SALT IS SAFE! Ultra Edge comes to his rescue. Slightly short in length around middle, Philip stands back to pull it across the line but fails to middle his shot. There is certainly some noise and the finger has gone up as soon as the appeal is made. Shaheen is celebrating but Salt reviews immediately. DRS overturns the onfield decision.
Philip Salt has been given out caught behind! He has reviewed it immediately though. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows a flat line and the decision is reversed.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, shaping down, Salt nudges it down to long leg and collects a couple of runs.
Zak Crawley is the next man in the middle. Can he continue his form from the last game?

OUT! Malan is gone! Caught at second slip. Loose shot from Dawid. Hasan tempts the southpaw with a driving length delivery outside off, Malan aims for a big booming cover drive but the away movement catches the outside edge and Shadab grabs a good low catch. Malan departs without troubling the scorers and Pakistan have got a perfect start. Hasan is celebrating in his typical style and the capacity crowd is loving it.
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish and on off, Malan drives it from the toe end of the bat to mid off.
Beaten again! This one holds its line after landing on a good length outside off, Malan has a tame push inside the line and misses. Testing over by Hasan!

Beautiful delivery. Hasan lands it on a length around middle and off, shaping in with extra bounce, Malan fails to defend and is hit on the back leg. A stifled appeal from the bowler dies down quickly. Too high.

Fractionally short and close to off, angling away, Malan goes on the back foot and tries to punch but gets an inside edge past the stumps. It rolls behind square leg, some thought is given to take a run but then they decide against it.
Hasan pitches it up and outside off, Malan drives it off his front foot to covers. This is looking like a good pitch for stroke-making. No real movement for the pacers thus far.
Ali starts with a wide down the leg side! It's on a length, Malan tries to buy cheap runs with a little flick but fails to connect.
Hasan Ali will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good length ball around off, Salt looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Smacked! This is a good start from Philip Salt! Shortish on off, Salt pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
PLAY AND A MISS! This is a loose shot from Salt! Good length ball outside off, Salt looks to drive it off the front foot but misses.
Shaheen bowls a good length ball outside off, it tails in but Salt watches it carefully and lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! That is a gorgeous way to get off the mark! Brilliant shot. Full on middle, Salt leans and creams the drive through mid off for a boundary.
Afridi starts with a good length ball on middle and leg, angling in. Salt goes on his back foot and then defends it towards mid on.

We are done with the pre-match formalities and we are all set to begin! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle, followed by Philip Salt and Dawid Malan. Shaheen Afridi will start with the ball for Pakistan.

Revised playing conditions - Powerplay 1 will be of usual 1 to 10 overs. Powerplay 2 will be between 11 and 38 overs. Powerplay 3 will be between overs 39 to 47. Two bowlers can bowl a maximum of 10 overs while three bowlers can bowl 9.
England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Zak Crawley, James Vince, Ben Stokes (C), John Simpson (WK), Lewis Gregory, Craig Overton, Brydon Carse, Saqib Mahmood, Matt Parkinson.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Imam-ul-Haq, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Saud Shakeel, Sohaib Maqsood, Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.

Toss - After all the delay, finally, we have both the captains in the middle. Ben Stokes flicks the coin, Babar Azam calls it correctly and PAKISTAN CHOOSE TO FIELD! The Pakistan skipper says that they want to use the conditions and win the match. The English skipper, on the other hand, also wanted to bowl first but feels that it's a good chance to put runs on the board. BOTH TEAMS ARE UNCHANGED!
Update 10.55 am GMT (11.55 am local) - The toss is to take place at 12.10 pm local time and the first ball is at 12.30 local time. THE MATCH IS REDUCED TO 47-OVERS-PER-SIDE.

Update 10.32 am GMT (11.32 am local) - Waiting for updates from our side? Well, we are also waiting for fresh updates from the ground. We are hearing that the conditions have not improved much and the drizzle is still on. Let's be patient together in front of this typical English weather.

Update 9.50 am GMT (10.50 am local) - Good news, folks! The rain has eased off and we are all set to have the toss at 11.15 am local (10.15 am GMT). Importantly, no overs have been lost. Get ready!
The significance of number 100 in this match - 1) It will be the 100th ODI for Ben Stokes. 2) Lord's is at 100 per cent capacity.

It's toss time, well, not really! The light drizzle continues to irritate everyone at Lord's and it has forced the groundsmen to keep the cover on. If a few trusted Twitter handles are to be believed, the conditions have brightened up slightly and it's a lot better than what it was a few minutes back. The good thing is that the weather radar for the afternoon is quite promising.

Weather update - There is a slight drizzle in the air at the moment in London. Not too worrisome though. The covers are out but in all likelihood, it will clear soon and we will have a prompt start. Fingers crossed.

Hello and welcome everyone for the second ODI between England and Pakistan in this 3-match series. We are here at Lord's and it's buzzing with spectators. It's a full house at the Mecca of Cricket. The hosts too will be brimming with confidence after the heroics in the last match, that too with a second-string team, and now will be aiming to close the series here. Pakistan, on the flip side, will be hurt and will be eyeing revenge. They were completely outclassed in Cardiff and suffered a humiliating loss. Can they make a comeback to level the series? Let's find out.
